image_description: A group of smiling graduates in an outdoor setting. The foreground features a female graduate wearing a black academic gown and mortarboard cap, holding a rolled diploma. To her left is a male graduate in a blue academic gown and cap. Background figures are blurred but also appear to be wearing graduation attire. The image captures a celebratory moment with shallow depth of field.
